title: Tamil Nadu
name: Tamil Nadu
intro: Tamil Nadu is the most stable map in this archive. Its assembly has had 234 seats since 1977, the state has not been divided, and the constituencies drawn by the 1976 order were contested seven times without interruption before the 2008 order replaced them. The comparison here is therefore a clean one: the same electorate, the same borders, the same number of seats, redrawn once after thirty years.
The assembly map Tamil Nadu used for seven elections

map_caveats: Unlike several other states in this archive, the two mapped layers for Tamil Nadu are already in register with one another and have not been adjusted. The outlines of the pre-2008 and post-2008 maps agree to an intersection-over-union of 0.98 as supplied.

Territory lineage for this state is inferred from boundary overlap rather than from the delimitation order texts, and every seat record says so. The 1976 order for Tamil Nadu was not available when this page was compiled, so the successor shown for each pre-2008 seat is the one holding the largest share of its area. Where the same method could be tested against order-derived lineage in other states, it agreed about four times in five.
Extent text is published for the post-2008 seats only, quoted from the 2008 order. The pre-2008 seats carry none, for the same reason.

Territory percentages are measured from the mapped boundaries in every case, and are areal shares, not shares of the electorate.
